name: watercolor_anime
description: A watercolour anime-film cast set in a seaside town at golden hour. The boss runs the shop, the worker does the deliveries, the analyst explains what the numbers mean.
style: Japanese animated-film background art painted in soft watercolour and gouache, visible brush strokes and paper grain, warm golden-hour light with gentle bloom, thin hand-drawn outlines in warm brown rather than black, nostalgic palette of peach orange, cream, soft teal and dusty blue, cinematic hand-painted anime look, no hard cel shading

background.prompt: A quiet seaside-town street at golden hour seen straight on, painted in soft watercolour. Low horizon two thirds down the frame. Upper third: a warm sunset sky with soft peach and cream clouds, a strip of glittering blue sea and a row of distant small tiled rooftops all staying behind the horizon line. Lower third: a sunlit asphalt road sloping gently toward the viewer, long warm shadows, a low white guardrail and small green hugging hedges only at the extreme left and right edges. Wide open empty sunlit middle with nothing in it.

boss.role: owns the shop and the capital - watches the till and the tide
boss.look: a tanned middle-aged shopkeeper, short greying hair, rolled-up white sleeves, a navy apron over a cream shirt, a small towel slung over one shoulder, dark cropped trousers, sandals

worker.role: does the actual running around - deliveries, errands, the real work
worker.look: a bright young worker in a white short-sleeved uniform shirt with a small red neckerchief, navy shorts, white socks and brown loafers, short dark hair, a canvas shoulder bag

analyst.role: the analyst who explains the mechanism with the chart
analyst.look: a composed young woman with a bob haircut and round thin-rimmed glasses, a cream linen shirt with rolled sleeves, olive cropped trousers, a brown leather satchel across one shoulder

_panel_color_note: Warm cream, matching the gouache paper tone, so a panel reads as a sunlit interior wall rather than a sticker on the sunset plate.
